title: Legal, Compliance & Privacy | Way2Paisa FinPro Services
description: Legal disclaimer, regulatory compliance, zero brokerage policy and privacy notice for Way2Paisa FinPro Services.
sections: All logos, brand names, trademarks, corporate identities and project images shown on this website remain the registered trademarks and property of their respective real estate developers, banks and Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs).

Way2Paisa FinPro Services is an independent real estate marketing and finance facilitator. Their inclusion is for identification, representational and informational purposes only. It does not create or imply a joint venture, partnership, endorsement or agency relationship with any developer, bank or NBFC unless expressly confirmed in writing.

This website is a marketing and informational platform. Project information is sourced from developers, public regulatory records and other identified sources. Homebuyers should independently verify the applicable MahaRERA registration number, promoter details, approved plans, possession commitments and official project information on the statutory MahaRERA website before booking or making a financial commitment.

Way2Paisa FinPro Services facilitates introductions to banks and NBFCs for relevant finance solutions. Loan approval, eligibility, interest rate, terms, processing fees, documentation requirements and disbursement remain solely at the discretion of the respective lending institution and are subject to its prevailing policies and applicable law.

We take reasonable care to keep information current. Project prices, unit availability, carpet areas, possession timelines, interest rates and financial terms may change without notice by developers or financial institutions. Information on this site should not be the sole basis for an investment, booking or financial decision. Way2Paisa FinPro Services is not liable for decisions made solely in reliance on website information.

Way2Paisa FinPro Services follows a zero brokerage policy for property buyers. We do not charge buyers brokerage, consultation fees or hidden service charges for eligible real-estate advisory or loan facilitation services. Any statutory charges, developer charges, lender charges or third-party professional fees, where applicable, will be separately disclosed by the relevant party.

When you submit your name, phone number, email address or other contact details, you authorise Way2Paisa FinPro Services and its representatives to contact you by call, SMS, WhatsApp or email about property and finance opportunities relevant to your request. This consent is subject to applicable law and the consent language presented with the form.

We use submitted information to process your enquiry, arrange appointments, share relevant information and provide requested assistance. We do not sell, rent or trade personal information to third-party marketing agencies. Information may be shared only with relevant developer, lender or service-provider teams where necessary to address your specific request, or where required by law.
